versions.name: Water Sports
versions.description: Get up behind a boat on a wakeboard or on skis, cross the wakes and return to center, fall clear of trouble, and signal the observer so the crew knows what you need.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
